description:
Configure and execute a multi-turbine Lifting Line Theory (LLT) simulation in QBlade to analyze wake shadowing.

Starting from the loaded 'Turbine Simulation' project, navigate to the LLT Simulation module and set up a scene with two instances of the turbine:
1. Place the first turbine at position (0, 0, 0).
2. Place the second turbine 50 meters downstream at position (50, 0, 0).

Configure the simulation with:
- Wind Speed: 12 m/s
- Timestep: 0.1 s
- Number of Timesteps: 200 (20 seconds total duration)

Run the simulation. Once complete, analyze the power output graphs for both turbines. The downstream turbine should show reduced power due to the wake effect.

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/wake_loss_report.txt' with the exact format:
Upstream Power: [Value] kW
Downstream Power: [Value] kW
Wake Loss: [Value] %

Finally, save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/projects/wake_study.wpa'.
